title: Request a replacement or cancellation of a Heavy Vehicle CBA Learner's Logbook
summary: Find out how to replace or cancel your Heavy Vehicle CBA Learner's Logbook if you are updating or converting to a different vehicle class.
intro:
When you're issued with your HVCBA Learner Licence, you'll receive a Learner Driver Logbook so you and your supervising driver(s) can record your driving performance.

If you need to replace or cancel your logbook because you're updating or converting to drive a vehicle from a different class, you'll need to visit a Service NSW Centre.

You may need to pay a replacement fee.
who_can_apply: You are updating or converting to drive a vehicle from a different class.
what_you_need: The PDF form: 'Replacement Learner's Logbook Application'
Payment for the replacement logbook (if applicable)

how_to_steps.text: Visit a service centre and submit your request.

faqs.q: What is a Learner Driver Logbook?
faqs.a: When you receive your HVCBA Learner Licence, you will get a Learner Driver Logbook to record your driving performance for you and your supervising driver(s).

faqs.q: When do I need to replace or cancel my logbook?
faqs.a: You need to replace or cancel your logbook if you are updating or converting to drive a vehicle from a different class.

faqs.q: Where do I submit my request?
faqs.a: You must visit a Service NSW Centre to submit your request.
